dedupe_keys.name: cineca marconi100 m100 and marconi a2 whole system telemetry from examon

description: Researchers of the University of Bologna and CINECA, the Italian supercomputing centre, publish telemetry collected by the ExaMon monitoring infrastructure from two Tier-0 supercomputers. The M100 dataset covers the whole Marconi100 system from March 2020 to September 2022 in twelve parts (about 400 GB): internal data of more than 980 compute nodes (core loads, temperatures, frequencies, memory operations, CPU power, fan speeds, GPU use) and system-wide data on the liquid cooling plant, air conditioning, power supply units, workload manager and jobs, system alerts and weather, with a time-aggregated part for anomaly detection. A second dataset gives inlet and outlet temperatures and power of 3,312 Marconi A2 nodes for 2019, prepared for the HazardNet thermal hazard prediction framework. Coverage: CINECA, Casalecchio di Reno (Bologna), Italy. Format and access: Parquet archives on Zenodo, free of charge under CC BY 4.0. Caveats: one HPC centre; very large; metric names need the documentation. Simulation uses: power, cooling and thermal behaviour of a large computing facility for data centre digital twins, thermal hazard and failure prediction, and demand on the power grid. Related records: SURF Lisa and the UCC 2023 cloud data centre logs; OpenDC simulates data centres.
